element_doc: Q211: phi on the cell is the tensor Lagrange interpolant of 'nodal' 'vals'[i][j][l] at local y1 = -1 + 2 i/2 (sigma), y2 = -1 + 2 j (ua), y3 = -1 + 2 l (ub), y in [-1, 1]^3 mapping the cell's sigma, ua, ub ranges; 'node_ids' are global unknown indices, equal ids carry the bit-identical value (cube seams and mirror-duplicated vertices are merged; every node at sigma = sigma_lo has id 0 = phi_lo). 'coef' are the float monomial coefficients of the same polynomial.
